filter.comment: Enumerate distinct video_uid from the fine-annotation CSV, restricted to ego rows (join.keep_where view=='ego'). The UUID include_regex also discards ~40 malformed rows where multi-line narration leaks into the video_uid column. Usable ego episodes ~421.

projection.notes: npy is (N_frames, 3) float32: col0=x_norm, col1=y_norm in [0,1], col2=binary validity. Invalid frames are stuffed with (0.5,0.5) -> MUST mask via col2 (else center placeholders read as real fixations). Time is implicit: frame i -> i/30 s; no timestamp column. Already normalized; multiply by frame W/H downstream if pixels wanted.

join.comment: Rows whose video_uid == episode id. view=='ego' selects egocentric; subset gives split. Stems are identical UUIDs across video/gaze/CSV (no transform).

metadata.notes: No general metadata file. fps for gaze is fixed 30 by construction. Video fps/dims via ffprobe. Other annotation files present but unused: fine_annotation_trainval_en.csv (subset), fine_annotation_test.csv (test id list), coarse_annotations.tar.gz, narration_{noun,verb}_taxonomy.csv.

provenance.notes: METADATA none. VIDEO videos/. GAZE gazes_30fps_npy/ (naming likely bijective to videos). ANNOTATIONS annotations/fine_annotation_trainvaltest_en.csv (video_uid->video/gaze, start_sec, end_sec, narration_en; preserve all). NOTE: some videos not mapped to gaze/anno -> drop. annotations/README.md has info.
decisions: Episode = ego video_uid, enumerated from fine-CSV ego rows (~421 usable: video+gaze+anno).
Gaze npy is (N,3) normalized x,y + validity flag; preserve validity (col2) and mask invalid (0.5,0.5) placeholders; time = frame/30.
Preserve annotation_id, scene, and the two GPT-rewrite text variants as extras.
ego/exo filter is on the annotation 'view' field (the only reliable discriminator), applied at join (keep_where view=='ego'), not on filename.
corrections: Gaze is (N,3) with a validity flag, not plain (N,2) x,y.
CSV has 10 columns (incl. view, subset, scene, two GPT rewrites), not the 4 in the notes; view/subset are essential.
Bijection is gaze<->ego only (428 gaze = 421 ego-with-anno + 7 ego-without-anno); 304 exo + others have no gaze.
~40 malformed CSV rows leak multiline text into video_uid; the UUID include_regex filters them.
open_questions: Coordinate origin (top-left vs bottom-left) and exact validity=0 semantics (blink/untracked/out-of-frame) are undocumented in README; strongly inferred, unconfirmed.
Whether to also emit the GPT-rewrite text variants as separate downstream channels or keep them only as extras on 'fine'.
